native_mechanisms: Two knot-cords laid crosswise over a sand-tray, their crossings marking a lattice of comparison points (one cell per symbol pair).

A single one-cell ink-worm walking the eight compass directions as one continuous traversal, curling back over its own trail to re-test a junction from another face until no junction can be improved (relaxation-until-stable, sand mounds as the only state).
A sideways furrow crossing that spends no sand, letting one cord slip a step ahead of the other (a free/zero-cost gap step).
core_technique: Standard Needleman-Wunsch global alignment DP computed in anti-diagonal wavefront order with three rolling O(n) diagonal buffers (b pre-reversed for unit-stride, auto-vectorizable inner loops), plus a two-row row-major DP fallback for n < 64.
